**Audio Studio MCP 1.3.0 adds local song generation with vocals.** Give YuE2 lyrics and a style description to generate a song with vocals and accompaniment. Stable Audio 3 continues to handle BGM, sound effects, and audio editing.

## Model terms and setup

The Audio Studio MCP code remains MIT-licensed. YuE2 is optional. Run `audio-studio-mcp song-setup` in the same environment you use for Audio Studio to install its pinned runtime and weights after reviewing the terms. The default Auto setup downloads about 2.93 GB or 4.53 GB of weights, depending on the selected profile. Run `audio-studio-mcp song-setup --check` to inspect installation and device readiness.

The YuE2 weights are licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0. YuE2 separately permits creators acting in an individual capacity to generate, publish, and monetize outputs subject to its responsible-use terms. Companies seeking commercial use of the weights should contact the model licensors. [YuE2 model terms](https://github.com/multimodal-art-projection/YuE/blob/1116bea76032bee5668e5f097294d082fa0b84f0/MODEL_LICENSE)

## Generate, listen, and export

- Open the **Songs** tab in the WebUI or call `generate_song` from an MCP client. Set lyrics, style, an optional title, and a seed. The default duration cap is 180 seconds and you can raise it to 240 seconds. Songs can end earlier, and new outputs that hit the cap fade out over the last two seconds.
- `generate_song` returns a job ID. Use `song_status` for progress and results and `cancel_song` to stop a job. The WebUI and chat player in MCP Apps clients also expose progress and cancellation. Text-only clients receive the result path through `song_status`.
- Preview songs in the WebUI or the chat player and export using Audio Studio's existing presets. The original is a 48 kHz stereo WAV. The saved metadata records the seed, model revisions, selected profile, actual duration, and runtime so you can regenerate from the saved settings.

## Auto selection and verified hardware

- **Auto** picks the highest-precision installed profile that fits current memory and the wait budget. **Fast** uses Q4_0 and **Highest quality** uses Q8_0. With both installed, Auto can retry at Q4_0 after a Q8_0 allocation failure if the remaining budget and memory allow it. Stable Audio 3 and YuE2 share a GPU queue.
- Estimated time is calibrated separately for short, medium, and long outputs on each device and profile. A short run leaves the long-song estimate at its policy value until a long run has been measured. Auto, job progress, and `song-setup --check` use the same estimator.
- Song generation was verified on Apple Silicon with Metal on a 32 GiB Mac and on Windows 11 x64 with a 12 GiB GeForce RTX 3060 and the pinned CUDA 13.3 runtime. The default macOS setup requires 32 GiB of unified memory and Xcode with the Metal compiler. Windows requires an NVIDIA R610 or newer driver and compute capability 7.5 or higher. These runtime requirements and the live memory checks govern profile eligibility. [Song setup and hardware guide](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp/blob/main/docs/song-generation.md)

All six README editions now link to song setup and usage. Regression coverage includes job lifecycle, replay, export, resource checks, duration-aware estimates, and the browser player.
